t: You're looking at a drinking fountain on Whitechapel Road, in Whitechapel, in the borough of Tower Hamlets. It's the King Edward the Seventh Jewish Memorial Drinking Fountain, and the king it commemorates is Edward the Seventh. He was King of the United Kingdom and Emperor of India from January 1901 until his death in 1910. So this is a small public memorial to a king, built as something people could actually use, a place to stop and take a drink on a busy road.
